meta.generationModel: two-stage: structural foundation selection, then harmonic color
meta.selectionModel: complete-path beam search — a chord is selected because its PATH won, not because it won its slot locally

context.fingerprintNote: Deterministic hash of the musically relevant project data. Reproducing this run requires the original project file; reference audio is never fingerprinted.

rhythm.continuationModelNote: The rhythm planner assigns exactly one foundation per slot; there is no explicit sustain decision at rhythm time. Continuation exists only as (a) the structural selector re-choosing the same foundation, or (b) the event-merging layer folding same-foundation slot runs into one sustained event.
